title: Finlay’s Bullet Club becomes the War Dogs
summary: David Finlay rejects the faction’s past and builds a harsher Bullet Club around the War Dogs. Their war with United Empire reaches a cage-match farewell for Will Ospreay.

chapters.title: Finlay attacks the departing leader
chapters.result: Finlay attacks Jay White after White’s loss to Eddie Kingston.
chapters.context: The assault positions Finlay against the old leadership as Bullet Club enters another transition.

chapters.title: Gedo backs Finlay
chapters.result: Gedo introduces Finlay as Bullet Club’s new leader.
chapters.context: Finlay gains the faction’s managerial support and begins reshaping the group around his own ambitions.

chapters.title: The War Dogs win the cage war
chapters.result: The War Dogs defeat United Empire in the Dog Pound cage match.
chapters.context: Finlay pins Ospreay in the faction battle that closes Ospreay’s run as a full-time New Japan wrestler.
